_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · genspark（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（manus/perplexity/tiangong），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [manus, perplexity, tiangong]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Multi-model orchestration (multiple models called inside agent workflows, official narrative); users do not pick bare models. The in-house line (Super Agent narrative) is mixed with third-party models; the list not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: Web (genspark.ai) + App (seen in the official-site navigation); generation on the vendor's cloud.
axes.local_files: Artifacts (reports/pages/sheets/PPTs) stored on the account-side cloud; downloads count as local. No officially stated local data surface seen.
axes.background: Task-based: submit a task → multi-step cloud execution → artifacts enter the account library (agent form); tasks run in the cloud independent of your machine being online.
axes.tools: **Search + report agent is the main axis**: Sparkpage (retrieval results reorganized into structured pages), AI Slides/Sheets/website generation (official-site product surface), browser extension (seen on the official site); multi-step tool calls (retrieval/code/image) inside the agent.
axes.context: Artifacts and history organized by task/project; cross-session memory not verified to an official statement (context continuity inside agent task lines not verified item by item).
axes.permissions: Account + credits/subscription system (D9: pricing not collected); the agent has web access and code-execution surfaces — think through what it will carry onto the network before uploading sensitive data (terms details not verified item by item).
axes.fit: Fits: "search → report → slides" one-stop pipelines, research delivery wanting ready-made artifacts, lightweight agent task outsourcing. Does not fit: wanting a controllable, auditable process (agent black-box degree), enterprise-compliance-first, mainland-direct-sensitive scenarios (direct 403 = CF challenge).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Artifact-quality triangle: same research question vs Manus/ChatGPT Deep Research**
- **Source retention of Sparkpage** (can you still trace back to the original after reorganization)
- **Credit consumption vs task complexity** (D9: pricing not collected; consumption behavior measured)
unknowns:
- The registered entity and team composition (no official statement verified)
- The model list called inside the agent (not inventoried item by item)
- The training-use switch (not verified item by item)
- Filing status (see the cn block — entity unclear)
related: Also task agents: Manus is a general-task cloud sandbox, Genspark leans toward research/content artifacts.
Also search-oriented: Perplexity is an answer engine, Genspark an artifact factory.
Also China-background super-agent: Tiangong does docs/PPT/sheets one-stop, Genspark has the Sparkpage line.
